DAVE THE DIVER - Subnautica 2 Content Pack – Reveal Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
DAVE THE DIVER - Subnautica 2 Content Pack arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch in early 2027! 

DAVE THE DIVER is swimming into the world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure! 

Join Dave and Bancho as they explore the mysterious waters of Proteus, make new discoveries, and lend a hand to new friends along the way. 

#DAVETHEDIVER #Subnautica2

He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction – Release Date – Nintendo Switch
He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction launches February 4, 2027 on Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6003aSJB1

Defend Eternia and experience 13 action-packed stages in He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction. Play as He-Man, She-Ra, Man-At-Arms, and Teela. Take on Skeletor's evil forces, and team up with a friend for local co-op action to double the fun!
